path.style: animation: var(--ind-girar, ob-girar 800ms linear infinite); transform-origin: 12px 12px

circle.style: animation: var(--ind-pulso, ob-pulso 2400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite); transform-origin: 12px 12px
stroke-dashoffset: calc(100 - var(--progreso, 0)); transition: stroke-dashoffset 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
